edits.what: Replace the paragraph under the verse with her own wording.
edits.from: That verse is why this kitchen exists. Good food, made slowly, handed to a neighbor is one of the plainest ways we know to show someone they are loved.
edits.to: That verse is the heart behind this kitchen. We believe there’s something special about good food made with care and shared with a neighbor—a simple way to remind someone they are seen and loved.
